latest_release.body: > [!NOTE] > This release includes security fixes (specifically from the the PHP security release 8.3.37), please make sure to upgrade as soon as possible. ## SSO OIDC Support (On-Premise Business) solidtime now supports **SSO logins via identity providers implementing OIDC** (Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra, Okta, Keycloak, Authentik, Zitadel, Authelia etc.). We published **detailed documentation** on how to set up SSO in solidtime in our [SSO Documentation](https://docs.solidtime.io/self-hosting/single-sign-on/), which also includes guides for * [Keycloak](https://docs.solidtime.io/self-hosting/single-sign-on/providers/keycloak) * [Microsoft Entra](https://docs.solidtime.io/self-hosting/single-sign-on/providers/microsoft-entra-id) * [Okta](https://docs.solidtime.io/self-hosting/single-sign-on/providers/okta) * [Google Workspaces](https://docs.solidtime.io/self-hosting/single-sign-on/providers/google-workspace) And you can use **any other identity provider that supports OIDC** too, by following the [Adding an identity provider](https://docs.solidtime.io/self-hosting/single-sign-on/adding-a-provider) instructions. The **SSO Extension** is part of the [solidtime On-Premise Business Plan](https://www.solidtime.io/pricing/on-premise). If you have any questions or need help during the configuration, please reach out via hello@solidtime.io ## Invoice Logos (On-Premise Business) The **Invoicing extension now supports Logos**, so you can customise your invoices to fit your branding. Logos will appear at the top right of your invoice and will be reused across all new invoices if you save them in the Default Settings. The default settings also have their own page now, so you can see all stored defaults on one page (/invoices/settings e.g. https://app.solidtime.io/invoices/settings) The Invoicing Extension is also part of the [solidtime On-Premise Business Plan](https://www.solidtime.io/pricing/on-premise). ## Other fixes & Improvements * Docker images are signed with cosign and come with an SBOM and provenance attestations ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1385 · Sign Docker images with cosign…](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1385)). * Server-Side Grouping time entries by date now respects daylight saving time ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1373](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1373)). * Dragging an event in the calendar no longer shifts it by the start-hour offset ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1362 · Fix calendar drag moving events…](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1362)). * A time entry’s client now stays in sync with its project ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1364](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1364)). * Project and task spent time is recalculated after an admin changes time entries ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1391](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1391)). * Registration keeps working when an accepted invitation can’t be turned into a membership ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1365](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1365)). * Yearly admin charts no longer miss months at the end of a month ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1353](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1353)). A TypeError when filling report gaps is fixed ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1358](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1358)). * Imports now validate user emails ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1375](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1375)). Email case is normalized in admin commands, the Filament user form, imports and placeholder merging ([solidtime-io/solidtime#1398](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/pull/1398)).

# solidtime - The modern Open-Source TimeTracker

[![GitHub License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/solidtime-io/solidtime?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/blob/main/LICENSE.md)
[![Codecov](https://img.shields.io/codecov/c/github/solidtime-io/solidtime?style=flat-square&logo=codecov)](https://codecov.io/gh/solidtime-io/solidtime)
![GitHub Actions Unit Tests Status](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/solidtime-io/solidtime/phpunit.yml?style=flat-square)
![PHPStan badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/PHPStan-Level_7-blue?style=flat-square&color=blue)

![Screenshot of the solidtime application with header: solidtime - The modern Open-Source Time Tracker](docs/solidtime-banner.png "solidtime Banner")

solidtime is a modern open-source time tracking application for Freelancers and Agencies.

## Features

 - Time tracking: Track your time with a modern and easy-to-use interface
 - Projects: Create and manage projects and assign project members
 - Tasks: Create and manage tasks and assign tasks to projects
 - Clients: Create and manage clients and assign clients to projects
 - Billable rates: Set billable rates for projects, project members, organization members and organizations 
 - Multiple organizations: Create and manage multiple organizations with one account
 - Roles and permissions: Create and manage organizations
 - Import: Import your time tracking data from other time tracking applications (Supported: Toggl, Clockify, Timeentry CSV)

## Self Hosting

If you are looking into self-hosting solidtime, you can find the guides [here](https://docs.solidtime.io/self-hosting/intro)

We also have an examples repository [here](https://github.com/solidtime-io/self-hosting-examples)

If you do not want to self-host solidtime or try it out you can sign up for [solidtime cloud](https://www.solidtime.io/)

## Issues & Feature Requests

If you 
* find any **bugs in solidtime**, please feel free to [**open an issue**](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/issues/new) in this repository, with instructions on how to reproduce the bug. 
* have a **feature request**, please [**create a discussion**](https://github.com/solidtime-io/solidtime/discussions/new?category=feature-requests) in this repository.


> **Do not use AI-generated text in issues, discussions and PR descriptions.**
>
> We are human, so please write in natural language in your issues, discussions, and PR descriptions.
> Don't be a meatproxy. We will ban people who repeatedly violate this rule from further communication on our repositories.


## Contributing

Please open an issue or start a discussion and wait for approval before submitting a pull request. This does not apply to tiny fixes or changes however, please keep in mind that we might not merge PRs for various reasons. 

**If you submit an AI slop pull request (especially without following the proper procedure), you will be banned from future contributions to solidtime.**

To keep that manageable, pull requests from authors who are not vouched are closed automatically, unless they change 50 lines or fewer. To get vouched, open an issue or discussion first and explain how you intend to implement the change. Once we have agreed on the approach, we vouch for you. See [Vouched contributors](./CONTRIBUTING.md#vouched-contributors).

Please read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before sumbitting a Pull Request.

We do accept contributions in the [documentation repository](https://github.com/solidtime-io/docs) f.e. to add new self-hosting guides.

## Security

Looking to report a vulnerability? Please refer our [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) file.

## License

This project is open-source and available under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL v3). Please see the [license file](LICENSE.md) for more information.
